One. You hear a coach.
You are throwing too quickly. Try slowly first and look at your team member. You do not need to throw very far.

Two. You hear a girl talking about a team.
We are not winning, but everyone is helping each other. That makes me happy. We are enjoying the game.

Three. You hear a pool announcement.
The large pool is closed today while we check the water. You can still use the small pool. Both will be open tomorrow.

Four. You hear a boy leaving a message.
Hi Mia. I am waiting in front of the stadium. Can you bring back my racket? You borrowed it yesterday, and I need it for practice today.

Five. You hear a teacher.
The game is finished. Please give the balls back before you leave. Then you can put on your jackets and go home.
